S.FORM: alang kobah ga niya mki sku Nanto Keng atu Nin'ay go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 56 buwan, 141 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 74% kyan ku 104 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 26% kyan ku 37 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 67%, Setik 4%, Bunun 1%, Cou 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na kobah hya' gargyax krahu'. tay 'zil na kobah hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na kobah hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na kobah hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na kobah hya' ga Malepa. tay 'zil na kobah hya' ga Masitoban. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ koβaħ ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku nanto keŋ atu ninʔaj ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** [s|ɕ]etik * βunun * [ʦ|ʨ]ou * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na koβaħ ħjaʔ ɣarɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na koβaħ ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na koβaħ ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na koβaħ ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na koβaħ ħjaʔ ɣa malepa taj ʔzil na koβaħ ħjaʔ ɣa ma[s|ɕ]itoβan reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
